question: What is the meaning of photochemical ozone in relation to essential environmental characteristics?
description:
Photochemical ozone refers to the formation of ground-level ozone through chemical reactions involving sunlight and pollutants. It is an essential environmental characteristic related to air quality and human health. <|ENDINPUT>
